title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Instant Access With an Open Shortfall
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — instant transfers to an external debit card while a shortfall is open.**

For the instant transfer amount an open shortfall is handled as the shortfall method below provides.

The shortfall method rests on the plan's open shortfall — its outstanding balance less the instant period taken less its fees carrying its next payday net of the fee reversals carrying that date — and on the shortfalls whose carryforward payday is its next payday:

1. when the open shortfall is above zero, does not exceed the tier's largest tolerated open shortfall on a tier whose share of access kept while a shortfall is open is above zero, and does not exceed the amount of those carried shortfalls, the instant percentage room and the instant pay-period room are each reduced by the open shortfall;
2. when it is above zero and within that limit on such a tier but exceeds the carried amount, the tier's access percentage and pay-period dollar ceiling are each multiplied by the tier's share of access kept while a shortfall is open, divided by one hundred, before the rooms are taken;
3. when it is above zero and above that limit, or on a tier whose share of access kept while a shortfall is open is zero, both rooms are zero;
4. when it is zero or less the rooms stand as stated for the instant transfer amount.

| Open shortfall | Tier keeps a share above zero, and shortfall within the tolerated amount | Shortfall within the amount carried to the next payday | Rooms |
|---|---|---|---|
| zero or less | — | — | as stated |
| above zero | yes | yes | each reduced by the open shortfall |
| above zero | yes | no | taken on the access percentage and ceiling multiplied by the share |
| above zero | no | — | both zero |

## Hypothetical cases on Paystride Access Premier (share kept 50 percent, tolerated 100.00 USD; access 50 percent, ceiling 1000.00 USD), instant accrued net 400.00 USD, nothing yet taken

- Open shortfall 52.80 USD, shortfalls carried to the next payday 52.80 USD: rooms 200.00 less 52.80, 147.20 USD, and 1000.00 less 52.80, 947.20 USD.
- Open shortfall 52.80 USD, carried 31.15 USD: access percentage 25 percent and ceiling 500.00 USD, rooms 100.00 and 500.00 USD.
- Open shortfall 120.00 USD: above the 100.00 USD tolerated, both rooms zero.
- On Paystride Access Plus (share kept 0 percent), any open shortfall above zero: both rooms zero.
